title: A site cannot claim the MAIL_FROM domain; a torn-down import is forgotten by its add-site host, handover line included; link rounds expire by the app clock
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/site-mail-domains.test.mjs — POST a site mail domain equal to (or under) the domain of MAIL_FROM
S2: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/sites-route.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/import-remove.test.mjs — DELETE a finished import and a built site
S3: node --test packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/site-hold.test.mjs — hold then forget a site with a handover line
S4: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/identity-store.test.mjs — approve/deny a link whose expiry is past by the app clock but not by Postgres now()
expect: S1: tracy.ai and Mail.Tracy.AI answer 400 DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED with no Resend call; shop.test is added; a row owning tracy.ai is never deleted

S2: a finished import deleted gets hold, forget, release at its add-site host after the row is gone; a built site gets no hold-door call; a host that hangs or throws never fails or holds the delete past 30 s
S3: the hold names the handover dump key; forget drops the site's handovers.json line and keeps other sites' lines; after release the same site starts again at once
S4: approveLink and denyLink answer false and the round stays pending; a round inside its window is approved

selectors.seam: tracyDomain (mail/site-mail/domains.js); forgetImportAtHost (sites/import-remove.js), closeBook (sites/route.js); forgetSiteRuns -> forgetHandover (tracy-add-site host/run.ts); approveLink/denyLink now (identity/store.js)

evidence: review of fix/mail-domain-forget-token-clock, 25/10/2026: the MAIL_FROM domain was not in tracyDomain; forgetSiteRuns left handovers.json; approveLink/denyLink compared expires_at with Postgres now() and went red under scripts/run-clock-shift.mjs
fence: only finished imports (origin 'migrated') are forgotten at the host; built sites keep their plain teardown

tests: tracyDomain: the domain of MAIL_FROM is Tracy's too; console mail adds none
the domain Tracy's system mail leaves from is refused to a site, and never deleted
DELETE /api/sites/:key: a finished import torn down asks its add-site host to forget the read; a built site does not
DELETE /api/sites/:key on a finished import keeps the plain teardown; its add-site host forgets the read after
forget takes the site’s runs, cursor, code and handover line; the hold named the store keys and stays as a tombstone
pgIdentityStore: a link round expires by the app clock, not the database clock
forgetImportAtHost: a host that hangs or a call that throws never holds or fails the delete
a finished import deleted by the site delete: forget then release, and the same address starts again at once
